summary.name: Rocky Sand Studio
summary.one_liner: Rocky Sand Studio is a developer of Mac utilities, news readers, and desktop social apps, including Disk Diag, Leaf, and FreeChat.
use_cases: clean up disk space on a Mac
read news and manage RSS subscriptions
access Gmail, Google Docs or Google Calendar as Mac apps
use WhatsApp or Messenger on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: The page is the landing page for Rocky Sand Studio, a Mac app developer. It lists its apps by category (Free, Utility, Social, News, Video). Featured apps include Disk Diag (listed as an amazing disk cleaner), Leaf (a news reader for managing subscriptions), Mail+, Docs+ and Cal+ (desktop access to Gmail, Google Docs and Google Calendar), FreeChat (WhatsApp and Messenger clients), and several utilities such as Memory Diag, Battery Monitor and The Duplicate Finder. The studio states it has 20M app downloads and 800K daily users, and links to its apps on the Mac App Store.
notable: Disk Diag disk cleaner and Leaf news reader among a catalogue of Mac apps
Desktop wrappers for Gmail, Google Docs, Google Calendar, WhatsApp and Messenger
caveats: Page does not state pricing for individual apps
Page does not describe specific features of each app in detail
